sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 764)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Metropolitan Opera basso Ezio Pinza singing grand arias on *The Bell Telephone Hour*, Edward de Souza as the Man in Black introducing internet terror on *Fear on Four* for BBC Radio 4, Marian Seldes in a chilling tale of criminal hubris on *CBS Radio Mystery Theater*, Canadian satirical comedy group *The Frantics* on CBC Radio, Scotland Yard's Inspector West on *Stand By for West*, and Ethelbert Nevin's parlor classic on *The Story Behind the Song*, Ezio Pinza (1944), Edward de Souza (1997), Marian Seldes (1998), The Frantics (1982), and Patrick Barr (1931–1998):
